item.title: Wakayama Power Spots: Koyasan Temples, Kumano Shrines & Sacred Mountains
item.description: The concept of power spots (パワースポット, pawā supotto) in Japanese popular spirituality refers to places where spiritual energy — ki, or in the Shinto context, the vitality of enshrined deities — is particularly concentrated and accessible to those who come seeking it. Wakayama Prefecture contains a density of spiritually significant sites with no parallel in Japan outside Kyoto — and unlike Kyoto, these sites were not built for aesthetic display but for the specific spiritual purpose of holding and transmitting sacred power.
